title: Lacunary Series, Nonlinear Functionals and Banach Space Structure
summary: In a previous paper \cite{BT} we studied the asymptotic behavior of $\| \sum_{k=1}^N a_k X_{n_k}\|_p$ for lacunary sequences $(X_{n_k})$ of random variables in $L_p$ and used the result to give a necessary and sufficient condition for the first alternative in the Kadec-Pełczynski theorem in the case $1\le p<2$. In the present paper we extend this result for nonlinear functionals $f_k (a_1 X_{n_1}, \ldots, a_k X_{n_k})$, establishing a uniform version of the subsequence principle of Aldous \cite{ald}. Moreover, we prove Kadec-Pełczynski type theorems in Orlicz spaces $L_ψ$.
